name: ghostwriter
title_zh: 提交记录里不留 AI 署名的 git 守门员
tagline_zh: 每次 commit、PR、merge 都自动剥掉 Co-Authored-By 和 AI 生成脚注。
tagline_en: Strips Co-Authored-By trailers and AI footers from every commit, PR, merge, rebase, tag—even when you forget to.
desc_en: Keep the AI out of git and GitHub authorship — no Co-Authored-By trailers, no "Generated with Claude Code" footers, no AI listed as a repo contributor. Use this whenever creating or amending commits, writing commit messages, opening or updating pull requests or issues, merging, squashing, rebasing, tagging, releasing, or pushing — any git or GitHub write operation — even when the user says nothing
why_zh: 不是事后清理，而是拦截在写入动作前。它理解 git 全生命周期操作，在用户沉默时也默认执行。
why_en: Not a cleanup tool—it intercepts before any git write. Covers the full lifecycle, defaults to stripping even when you say.
limit_zh: 只处理 git/github 写入操作，不碰文件内容本身；若你确实想让 AI 署名，需显式配置例外名单。
limit_en: Only affects git/GitHub write ops, never file contents. If you truly want AI credit, you must configure an explicit allowlist—otherwise it strips.
title_en: Git commit hygiene: keep AI authorship out
